description: Shared helper functions for comparing log graphs in testing scripts, includes log sanitization and comparison functions.

methods.name: sanitize_log_output
methods.description: Sanitizes git log output for comparison by removing variable parts such as commit hashes and merge info.

methods.name: lib_test_cmp_graph
methods.description: Compares the current git log graph against expected output after sanitization.

methods.name: lib_test_cmp_short_graph
methods.description: Runs a short-format git log graph, sanitizes, and compares with expected output.

methods.name: lib_test_cmp_colored_graph
methods.description: Generates a colored git log graph, decodes colors, sanitizes, and compares with expected output.
